They secrete androgen-binding protein (ABP), which binds testosterone and facilitates its action in the seminiferous tubules, thus supporting spermatogenesis. While Sertoli cells respond to follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH), they do not secrete FSH or luteinizing hormone (LH), as these hormones are produced by the pituitary gland. Therefore, the only correct option regarding what Sertoli cells secrete is androgen-binding protein (ABP).
